## Problem

Describe the reusable problem and why it belongs in the headless core.

## Public behavior

List API, schema, persisted-format, error-code, or compatibility changes. Write “none” when unchanged.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated deterministic tests.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] I updated the changelog or documented why no entry is needed.
- [ ] I did not add learner data, credentials, or restricted content.
- [ ] I documented the origin and license of imported material.
- [ ] I introduced no runtime dependency, or included a reviewed design decision justifying it.

## Evidence

Include concise test output, reproduction details, or migration notes. Do not attach sensitive archives or private screenshots.
